verdict.rationale: Capacities documents an official Model Context Protocol integration (docs-1/17) and a dedicated MCP server page confirmed by probe (capacities-probe-3), plus 'Chat Connectors' letting external AI agents (ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, Le Chat) connect to a Capacities space (docs-3), backed by a REST API with bearer/OAuth auth (docs-18, docs-33). Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification that an agent actually connects and operates via this MCP server, and more detail on the tools/resources exposed by the server.
